pages.title: What it does
text: After armor, resistance effects and Protection have all been settled, it multiplies a further percentage reduction on top. It therefore chains with the armor stat instead of double-counting it.

Permanent bypasses (hard-coded, cannot be removed by config): minecraft:generic_kill from /kill, minecraft:out_of_world from the void, and anything tagged BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. This keeps admins able to end a player and prevents surviving in the void.
The damage_reduction.applies_to_bypass_armor option (default true) and extra_bypass_damage_types list (empty by default, append-only) let you fine-tune this.
It is the only dimension in the whole mod that still has diminishing returns - because its 90% ceiling must stay out of reach forever.

pages.title: Flat (numeric) line
text: The curve is still SATURATING: gain = 60 * x / (x + 80) percentage points.

The asymptote is 60 percentage points and is never reached. The 80th point is the half-saturation point. This line was deliberately not converted to LINEAR, so the never-immune guarantee keeps holding.

pages.title: Percent line
text: Also SATURATING: gain = 75 * x / (x + 80), on the DESIGN_BASELINE basis with reference B_ref = 40 percentage points.
This line asymptotes at +30 percentage points (40 * 75/100).

pages.title: Ceiling & returns
text: The two lines add up: flat asymptotes at 60 and percent at 30, so the ceiling is 90%.

Both are saturating curves, strictly below their own asymptote, so 90% is unreachable: at 10 000 points the two lines together give 89.2857. A player always takes at least 10% of the damage - the mathematical "never immune" guarantee still holds.
Chained after armor's 80%, the worst case is D * 0.2 * 0.1 = 2% of the damage (98% total reduction), but still not invulnerability.

pages.title: Practical advice
text: This is where defensive growth actually lives. It is also the only dimension that keeps diminishing returns and the only one with a mathematical safety proof left.
Because it is applied after armor, "80% armor + 90% reduction" multiplies rather than adds, and both layers are worth stacking.
Remember that /kill and the void always ignore it, so no amount of points makes standing at the void's edge safe.
